meta.title: Fallen Starfire - 2
meta.description: In the abyss of slaughter, the warriors behold a miraculous starlight shining through the darkness.

units.rawText: Why are their numbers growing... They're really getting on my nerves!
units.displayText: Why are their numbers growing... They're really getting on my nerves!

spans.text: Why are their numbers growing... They're really getting on my nerves!

units.rawText: Persicaria, are you okay? How much operands have you got left?
units.displayText: Persicaria, are you okay? How much operands have you got left?

spans.text: Persicaria, are you okay? How much operands have you got left?

units.rawText: <size=28>...Once again, I've made the wrong decision.</size>
units.displayText: ...Once again, I've made the wrong decision.

spans.text: ...Once again, I've made the wrong decision.

units.rawText: I always make the wrong choice.
units.displayText: I always make the wrong choice.

spans.text: I always make the wrong choice.

units.rawText: Those choices—whether to head to the Oasis, which route to take, whether to leave Knot behind to cover our retreat—each and every one of them had presented me numerous possibilities. Yet, every time, I ended up choosing the worst one. This time was no different. I should never have risked going after resources when Lind had just left us.
units.displayText: Those choices—whether to head to the Oasis, which route to take, whether to leave Knot behind to cover our retreat—each and every one of them had presented me numerous possibilities. Yet, every time, I ended up choosing the worst one. This time was no different. I should never have risked going after resources when Lind had just left us.

spans.text: Those choices—whether to head to the Oasis, which route to take, whether to leave Knot behind to cover our retreat—each and every one of them had presented me numerous possibilities. Yet, every time, I ended up choosing the worst one. This time was no different. I should never have risked going after resources when Lind had just left us.

units.rawText: I ought to have been someone like Dr. Persica and Professor Irida, shining like a sun to light everyone's path. But I've proven to be a false light, an artificial source that dims in the face of difficulty, leading us all to a bottomless abyss. Now, I'm paying the price for my wrong decisions, as fate takes everything from me.
units.displayText: I ought to have been someone like Dr. Persica and Professor Irida, shining like a sun to light everyone's path. But I've proven to be a false light, an artificial source that dims in the face of difficulty, leading us all to a bottomless abyss. Now, I'm paying the price for my wrong decisions, as fate takes everything from me.

spans.text: I ought to have been someone like Dr. Persica and Professor Irida, shining like a sun to light everyone's path. But I've proven to be a false light, an artificial source that dims in the face of difficulty, leading us all to a bottomless abyss. Now, I'm paying the price for my wrong decisions, as fate takes everything from me.

units.rawText: I've come to understand that I'm nothing but a faker, destined never to be like the Doctor or the Professor. Reality has given me this answer.
units.displayText: I've come to understand that I'm nothing but a faker, destined never to be like the Doctor or the Professor. Reality has given me this answer.

spans.text: I've come to understand that I'm nothing but a faker, destined never to be like the Doctor or the Professor. Reality has given me this answer.

units.rawText: Still, at the very least, I shouldn't let others bear the consequences of my wrong choices.
units.displayText: Still, at the very least, I shouldn't let others bear the consequences of my wrong choices.

spans.text: Still, at the very least, I shouldn't let others bear the consequences of my wrong choices.

units.rawText: Persicaria?
units.displayText: Persicaria?

spans.text: Persicaria?

units.rawText: If walking the right path comes at the cost of only my sacrifice, it would have been so much simpler.
units.displayText: If walking the right path comes at the cost of only my sacrifice, it would have been so much simpler.

spans.text: If walking the right path comes at the cost of only my sacrifice, it would have been so much simpler.

units.rawText: ...Sol, it's been an honor to fight alongside you, but I'm afraid it's time we part ways.
units.displayText: ...Sol, it's been an honor to fight alongside you, but I'm afraid it's time we part ways.

spans.text: ...Sol, it's been an honor to fight alongside you, but I'm afraid it's time we part ways.

units.rawText: I know it's selfish, but I want the rest of us to survive.
units.displayText: I know it's selfish, but I want the rest of us to survive.

spans.text: I know it's selfish, but I want the rest of us to survive.

units.rawText: I'll use the remaining operands I have to self-destruct. That should buy you some time—use it to make an escape.
units.displayText: I'll use the remaining operands I have to self-destruct. That should buy you some time—use it to make an escape.

spans.text: I'll use the remaining operands I have to self-destruct. That should buy you some time—use it to make an escape.

units.rawText: What are you doing, you dork?!
units.displayText: What are you doing, you dork?!

spans.text: What are you doing, you dork?!

units.rawText: Sol swings her sword fiercely, slashing at her enemies, firmly rejecting Persicaria's absurd suggestion. As someone who values her friends' lives more than her own, Sol simply cannot accept such an ultimatum under any circumstances.
units.displayText: Sol swings her sword fiercely, slashing at her enemies, firmly rejecting Persicaria's absurd suggestion. As someone who values her friends' lives more than her own, Sol simply cannot accept such an ultimatum under any circumstances.

spans.text: Sol swings her sword fiercely, slashing at her enemies, firmly rejecting Persicaria's absurd suggestion. As someone who values her friends' lives more than her own, Sol simply cannot accept such an ultimatum under any circumstances.

units.rawText: This is the only way out! Otherwise, we're both gonna die here!
units.displayText: This is the only way out! Otherwise, we're both gonna die here!

spans.text: This is the only way out! Otherwise, we're both gonna die here!

units.rawText: ...Take care of the others, Sol.
units.displayText: ...Take care of the others, Sol.

spans.text: ...Take care of the others, Sol.

units.rawText: I know you'll be a better leader than me, and I know you'll find that person who'll truly lead us to freedom...
units.displayText: I know you'll be a better leader than me, and I know you'll find that person who'll truly lead us to freedom...

spans.text: I know you'll be a better leader than me, and I know you'll find that person who'll truly lead us to freedom...

units.rawText: The operands in my hands finish coalescing. I turn towards the direction Sol is facing, release an attack, and then push Sol aside with my Etheric Field.
units.displayText: The operands in my hands finish coalescing. I turn towards the direction Sol is facing, release an attack, and then push Sol aside with my Etheric Field.

spans.text: The operands in my hands finish coalescing. I turn towards the direction Sol is facing, release an attack, and then push Sol aside with my Etheric Field.

units.rawText: Self-detonation program... Ready. <size=40>Sol, run away!</size>
units.displayText: Self-detonation program... Ready. Sol, run away!

spans.text: Self-detonation program... Ready.
Sol, run away!

units.rawText: The surging operands have drawn the Sanctifiers' attention. They've re-evaluated my threat level and are quickly surrounding me, intent on destroying me before I detonate.
units.displayText: The surging operands have drawn the Sanctifiers' attention. They've re-evaluated my threat level and are quickly surrounding me, intent on destroying me before I detonate.

spans.text: The surging operands have drawn the Sanctifiers' attention. They've re-evaluated my threat level and are quickly surrounding me, intent on destroying me before I detonate.

units.rawText: Their movements fall all according to my plan. I push myself to adjust the operand distribution to catch as many as possible in the explosion radius, all while barely managing to block their attacks with my shield.
units.displayText: Their movements fall all according to my plan. I push myself to adjust the operand distribution to catch as many as possible in the explosion radius, all while barely managing to block their attacks with my shield.

spans.text: Their movements fall all according to my plan. I push myself to adjust the operand distribution to catch as many as possible in the explosion radius, all while barely managing to block their attacks with my shield.

units.rawText: It's time to end all of this...
units.displayText: It's time to end all of this...

spans.text: It's time to end all of this...

units.rawText: My hand grazes the name tag as I reach for the activation button. It reminds me of the day Dr. Persica and Professor Irida handed it to me... Doctor, Professor, tell me, am I finally making the right choice?
units.displayText: My hand grazes the name tag as I reach for the activation button. It reminds me of the day Dr. Persica and Professor Irida handed it to me... Doctor, Professor, tell me, am I finally making the right choice?

spans.text: My hand grazes the name tag as I reach for the activation button. It reminds me of the day Dr. Persica and Professor Irida handed it to me... Doctor, Professor, tell me, am I finally making the right choice?

units.rawText: Still, I hate that I'll be meeting my end whilst under the Sanctifier's gunpoint.
units.displayText: Still, I hate that I'll be meeting my end whilst under the Sanctifier's gunpoint.

spans.text: Still, I hate that I'll be meeting my end whilst under the Sanctifier's gunpoint.

units.rawText: <size=40>Bang! Bang-bang!</size>
units.displayText: Bang! Bang-bang!

spans.text: Bang! Bang-bang!

units.rawText: Gunshots from an unknown third party suddenly pierce through the battlefield. Two shots take down the Sanctifiers closest to me before I can even react, creating a small gap in their tight encirclement.
units.displayText: Gunshots from an unknown third party suddenly pierce through the battlefield. Two shots take down the Sanctifiers closest to me before I can even react, creating a small gap in their tight encirclement.

spans.text: Gunshots from an unknown third party suddenly pierce through the battlefield. Two shots take down the Sanctifiers closest to me before I can even react, creating a small gap in their tight encirclement.

units.rawText: <size=40>Quickly, now!</size>
units.displayText: Quickly, now!

spans.text: Quickly, now!

units.rawText: —Reprogramming!
units.displayText: —Reprogramming!

spans.text: —Reprogramming!

units.rawText: My body moves before my mind. The concentrated operands, originally reserved for self-detonation, are unleashed toward the gap, carving a new path to escape.
units.displayText: My body moves before my mind. The concentrated operands, originally reserved for self-detonation, are unleashed toward the gap, carving a new path to escape.

spans.text: My body moves before my mind. The concentrated operands, originally reserved for self-detonation, are unleashed toward the gap, carving a new path to escape.

units.rawText: As I break through the encirclement, I glance toward the source of the gunshots. It's a man in a lab coat. I don't know him, yet there's something strangely familiar about him.
units.displayText: As I break through the encirclement, I glance toward the source of the gunshots. It's a man in a lab coat. I don't know him, yet there's something strangely familiar about him.

spans.text: As I break through the encirclement, I glance toward the source of the gunshots. It's a man in a lab coat. I don't know him, yet there's something strangely familiar about him.

f.displayText: As I break through the encirclement, I glance toward the source of the gunshots. It's a woman in a lab coat. I don't know her, yet there's something strangely familiar about her.

spans.text: As I break through the encirclement, I glance toward the source of the gunshots. It's a woman in a lab coat. I don't know her, yet there's something strangely familiar about her.

units.rawText: Fate didn't allow me to submit, and directed me towards another path. Where does this path lead? To disaster, or an unseen miracle?
units.displayText: Fate didn't allow me to submit, and directed me towards another path. Where does this path lead? To disaster, or an unseen miracle?

spans.text: Fate didn't allow me to submit, and directed me towards another path. Where does this path lead? To disaster, or an unseen miracle?

units.rawText: <size=40>—Move! To 9 o'clock!</size>
units.displayText: —Move! To 9 o'clock!

spans.text: —Move! To 9 o'clock!

units.rawText: The shout isn't directed at me. At the moment, I can only feel a heat wave rushing in, and I'm suddenly spun around. Before I can grasp what's happening, I find myself slung over Sol's shoulder.
units.displayText: The shout isn't directed at me. At the moment, I can only feel a heat wave rushing in, and I'm suddenly spun around. Before I can grasp what's happening, I find myself slung over Sol's shoulder.

spans.text: The shout isn't directed at me. At the moment, I can only feel a heat wave rushing in, and I'm suddenly spun around. Before I can grasp what's happening, I find myself slung over Sol's shoulder.

units.rawText: Swiftflame Slash!!
units.displayText: Swiftflame Slash!!

spans.text: Swiftflame Slash!!

units.rawText: Wh-What are you doing!?
units.displayText: Wh-What are you doing!?

spans.text: Wh-What are you doing!?

units.rawText: Is that obvious? Someone came to save us! Of course now I'm running away with you!
units.displayText: Is that obvious? Someone came to save us! Of course now I'm running away with you!

spans.text: Is that obvious? Someone came to save us! Of course now I'm running away with you!

units.rawText: I've got my own legs to run with! But you're injured...
units.displayText: I've got my own legs to run with! But you're injured...

spans.text: I've got my own legs to run with! But you're injured...

units.rawText: I run faster! It's normal to lose a limb these days, and they don't cause me any pain anyway. Just stay put up there!
units.displayText: I run faster! It's normal to lose a limb these days, and they don't cause me any pain anyway. Just stay put up there!

spans.text: I run faster! It's normal to lose a limb these days, and they don't cause me any pain anyway. Just stay put up there!

units.rawText: Sol unleashes the few remaining operands she has left with a powerful slash, while I gently touch her wounds and begin healing. Her fierce attack temporarily halts the Sanctifiers' advance. With the man providing backline support, it truly feels like we might finally escape their pursuit.

Her fierce attack temporarily halts the Sanctifiers' advance. With the man providing backline support, it truly feels like we might finally escape their pursuit.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry, Sol.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry, Sol.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry, Sol.

units.rawText: Leave that for later! Persicaria, I need to ask you something.
units.displayText: Leave that for later! Persicaria, I need to ask you something.

spans.text: Leave that for later! Persicaria, I need to ask you something.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry about Knot.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry about Knot.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry about Knot.

units.rawText: No, I don't mean that.
units.displayText: No, I don't mean that.

spans.text: No, I don't mean that.

units.rawText: I was gonna ask, just how much material did Dr. Persica allocate to your breasts? You feel so much heavier now that I'm carrying you...
units.displayText: I was gonna ask, just how much material did Dr. Persica allocate to your breasts? You feel so much heavier now that I'm carrying you...

spans.text: I was gonna ask, just how much material did Dr. Persica allocate to your breasts? You feel so much heavier now that I'm carrying you...

units.rawText: At that moment, a faint noise crackles through our comms, delivering a set of coordinates.
units.displayText: At that moment, a faint noise crackles through our comms, delivering a set of coordinates.

spans.text: At that moment, a faint noise crackles through our comms, delivering a set of coordinates.

units.rawText: It's likely from the one who helped us. Let's head to the coordinates and rendezvous with them.
units.displayText: It's likely from the one who helped us. Let's head to the coordinates and rendezvous with them.

spans.text: It's likely from the one who helped us. Let's head to the coordinates and rendezvous with them.

units.rawText: Of course, leave it to me!
units.displayText: Of course, leave it to me!

spans.text: Of course, leave it to me!

units.rawText: She holds me tightly as she rushes toward the coordinates we just received, leaving the sound of gunshots fading behind us...
units.displayText: She holds me tightly as she rushes toward the coordinates we just received, leaving the sound of gunshots fading behind us...
